title: Equal Opportunity Cell | KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University Equal Opportunity Cell ABOUT EOC Equity & inclusion across the university Equal Opportunity Cell (EOC) has been established under the provision of University Grants Commission, 2012 Regulation (Promotion of Equity in Higher Educational Institutions) at Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara to make the present education system inclusive, to become more responsive to the needs and constraints of the disabled social groups. EOC shall ensure that students, staffs, faculties or the community from various diverse backgrounds, caste, creed, religion, language, ethnicity, gender and disability are not deprived of their righteous opportunities in terms of providing equity, free from any form of harassment, opportunities to higher educational institution, free from ragging, unfavorable treatment and victimization. The University aims to provide equal opportunities among the community and enhance diversity within the campus. COMMITTEE OBJECTIVES Objectives of the Cell Objective 01 To safeguard the interest of the students without any prejudice to their caste, creed, religion, language, ethnicity, gender and disability. Objective 02 To eliminate discrimination against or harassment by prohibiting it and by providing preventive and protective measures to facilitate its eradication and punishments. Objective 03 To promote equality among students of all sections of the society. Objective 04 To provide Equal Opportunity for all and not to discriminate against students belonging to SC and ST in admission. Objective 05 To resolve the issues pertaining to caste, creed, religion, language, ethnicity, gender and disability of access among the students, staff & faculties. Objective 06 To provide a platform for listening to complaints and redressal of grievances, if any. Objective 07 To foster healthy relationship with all. Yadav 7861805157 COMPLAINT PROCEDURE How to Submit An aggrieved person (who has been victimized) may launch the complaints by sending an email to: Sending an email eoc@kpgu.ac.in Important Registration Notes Submit the complaint within one month from the date of the incident or last incident in a series. Include full name, designation, mobile no, email id, and enrolment no in case of student. Describe the incident clearly, including date, time, location, respondent's name and relationship. The committee follows the KPGU policy on the prevention of discriminations among all. CONTACT DETAILS Reach Out Anti Discrimination Committee Drs.
